sources: Aeon's End: The New Age rulebook (Indie Boards & Cards, via RulesPal)

modules.name: Expedition
modules.note: Campaign of 4 battles using the Barracks.

steps.text: Each player chooses a breach mage and lays out its mat (room left for deck, right for discard, above for breaches)
steps.note: Expedition: only mages in the Barracks

steps.text: Take your STARTHAND (SD cards) into hand; build your STARTDECK in the exact order on your mat - never shuffle it
Follow any setup instructions on the back of your mage
Treasures for this battle: battle 2 tier 1; battle 3 tiers 1-2; battle 4 tiers 1-3
steps.note: Tier 1 replaces a Splinter/Spark in your deck; tier 2 one for the group; tier 3 on your mat

steps.text: Lay out breaches I-IV as your mat shows: active faceup, dark facedown with the bright area pointing as shown
{n} life tokens on your mat's LIFE area
9 Supply stacks: 4 Spells (5 each), 3 Crystals (7 each), 2 Artifacts (5 each) - free choice or by selector cards
Choose from the Barracks; banish the Supplies not chosen for the rest of the expedition
Choose a nemesis (difficulty on the back of its mat); room below for its play area
steps.note: Further expeditions: draw a nemesis selector for this battle

steps.text: Shuffle GENERAL cards by level; draw level 1/2/3: {n}
Each UPGRADED card received replaces one GENERAL card of its level
Mix each level with that nemesis's own cards of the level; stack level 3 at the bottom, 2, then 1 on top - don't shuffle
Carry out the "In Setup" instructions on the nemesis mat's back
Nemesis dial to its life; Gravehold dial to {n}
Randomly deal turn order tokens 1..players
Give the No Choice token to a random player
Place the 1/2 token between two neighbors and the 3/4 token between the other two
Turn order deck: 2 Nemesis cards + {p}; shuffle facedown
Use the two 1/2 and two 3/4 turn order cards instead
Read the nemesis's SPECIAL RULES before starting
Your deck is never shuffled
Flip the top turn order card to see who goes first
